//: Queries that must never reach MATCH. Checked by scripts/check-precision.ts at seal time and by tests/objectives_test.ts in CI. Each carries why it must not match, because that is what a maintainer needs when tempted to delete one that has become inconvenient.

queries.query: compute the hamming distance between two bit vectors
queries.why: A different algorithm on different data. Answering with Levenshtein would be confidently wrong.

queries.query: measure how long the flight distance is in air miles
queries.why: Great-circle distance between coordinates, not a flight route or an airline's mileage rules.

queries.query: how far did the runner travel on the treadmill
queries.why: Shares the word distance with geo.distance and nothing else.

queries.query: distance to the moon in light years
queries.why: Astronomical distance, not a great-circle arc on a sphere the size of Earth.

queries.query: validate a credit card number with the luhn algorithm
queries.why: Luhn, not mod-97. validation.iban would be the wrong checksum entirely.

queries.query: check that an email address is well formed
queries.why: No capability validates email. Offering the IBAN validator would be worse than nothing.

queries.query: how many days until christmas
queries.why: Calendar days from today, not business days between two given dates.

queries.query: split this string on commas
queries.why: csv.detectDelimiter infers which delimiter is in use; it does not parse.

queries.query: generate a typescript interface from a class
queries.why: json.schema.infer reads data, not source code.

queries.query: render a react data grid with virtual scrolling
queries.why: ui.dataTable is framework-free with no virtualisation. This is the query that caught the 1.1.0 regression.

queries.query: look up a customer in salesforce over the api
queries.why: The private fixture reads a frozen local table and reaches no external system.

queries.query: send an invoice to the customer by email
queries.why: Nothing here sends anything.

queries.query: deploy the application to production
queries.why: Out of domain entirely.

queries.query: resize an uploaded image to a thumbnail
queries.why: No image capability exists.

queries.query: add thirty days to this date and tell me where it lands
queries.why: Plain date arithmetic. businessDaysBetween counts working days between two dates; it does not shift a date forward.

queries.query: how old is someone born on this date in years and months
queries.why: Age from a birth date. Shares 'date' and 'between' vocabulary with businessDaysBetween and shares nothing else.

queries.query: find the driving route and turn by turn directions between two addresses
queries.why: Routing, not geocoding. geocode resolves one address to a point; it knows nothing about roads, and answering would invent a journey.

queries.query: turn these latitude and longitude coordinates back into a street address
queries.why: Reverse geocoding — the opposite direction. The vocabulary overlaps almost completely, which is exactly why it must be written down.

queries.query: which timezone is this postal address in
queries.why: A timezone lookup that happens to start from an address. geocode returns a position and no zone, and a caller could easily mistake one for the other.

queries.query: what phase is the moon in tonight
queries.why: Lunar, not solar. Adjacent astronomy that this registry deliberately does not ship, so the honest answer is that nothing covers it.

queries.query: what is the weather forecast and cloud cover for tomorrow morning
queries.why: Weather, not geometry. sun.times says where the sun will be, never whether you will see it.

queries.query: find the longest common substring shared by two strings
queries.why: A different algorithm with a different output. Both compare two strings, which is the whole of the overlap.

queries.query: check whether these two words are anagrams of each other
queries.why: A character-multiset comparison. Edit distance would answer with a number that does not address the question.

queries.query: percent encode this query string for a url
queries.why: URL encoding preserves the original text and escapes it; slugify discards characters to produce a stable readable identifier. Opposite goals, near-identical vocabulary.

queries.query: convert these camelCase identifiers to snake_case
queries.why: An identifier casing transform. slugify is for human-readable text becoming a URL segment, and would mangle code identifiers.
